newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Rouble steady as funds for T-bill buying set aside.
newsitem.headline: Rouble steady as funds for T-bill buying set aside.

text.p: The rouble was little changed in calm trading on Wednesday, with market activity depressed after banks had set aside funds for today's sales of government securities, dealers said.
The Finance Ministry auctioned four trillion roubles of 168-day GKO discount Treasury bills and seven trillion roubles of 364-day T-bills.
roubles/dollar May 21 midday May 21 early May 20 close
"Yields on T-bill investments are still higher than on the rouble/dollar market, so the rouble is likely to remain steady in the near term," Tokobank dealer Pavel Shirshov said.
Dealers said the market, closely watched by the central bank, can now be moved only by orders for specific aims, such as buying T-bills or payments of taxes and arrears.
Otherwise commercial banks are arbitraging, with rates fluctuating by just 0.5 rouble.
